lede: Houston carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.8 against -3.5, a 5.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Georgia Southern +10.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Houston winning 76% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offense, where Houston leads Georgia Southern by 101 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
